note_en: In a 比 comparison, 多了 after the adjective doesn't mean something has happened; it intensifies the comparison: 运费也比过去便宜多了 "shipping is much cheaper than it used to be." Compare plain 便宜了 "it's gotten cheaper." The text also uses the near-synonym 得多 in 比国内购物麻烦得多 "much more of a hassle than shopping domestically"; both go after the adjective, whereas English puts "much" before it.
